summary: Kroger filed an 8-K reporting an ordinary debt capital markets take-down under its April 2026 shelf registration. On September 28, 2026, the retailer priced $650 million of 5.800% senior notes due 2032 and $850 million of 6.200% senior notes due 2036, with Citigroup, Mizuho and Wells Fargo as underwriter representatives; supplemental indentures are dated October 5, 2026. Proceeds will refinance October 2026 maturities and fund general corporate purposes. No special-situation catalyst, board recommendation, premium, or structural overhang applies; the risk-arb angle is merely spread and refinancing-cost tracking.
